name: @pipeworx/mcp-unesco-uis

tools.name: get_data
tools.description: Fetch UNESCO UIS statistic values: education, literacy, school enrollment/completion, science (R&D) and culture indicators. Returns {records:[{indicatorId,geoUnit,year,value}]}. Indicator IDs come from list_indicators; geoUnit is an ISO3 country code (e.g. "BRA") from list_geounits. Both accept one or many (comma-separated) values; empty records means no data for that indicator/country/year combination.

indicator.description: Indicator ID(s) from list_indicators, e.g. "CR.1" or "10". Multiple comma-separated: "CR.1,CR.2".

geoUnit.description: ISO3 country/region code(s) from list_geounits, e.g. "BRA". Multiple comma-separated: "BRA,ARG".

tools.name: list_indicators
tools.description: Browse/search the UNESCO UIS indicator catalog (education, literacy, enrollment, science/R&D, culture). Filter by case-insensitive name substring. Each entry has indicatorCode (pass as `indicator` to get_data), name, theme and data availability (year range, record count).

search.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against indicator name, e.g. "literacy".

tools.name: list_geounits
tools.description: List UNESCO UIS geographic units (countries/regions) with their ISO3 code (id), name and type. Use the id as `geoUnit` in get_data. Optional case-insensitive name substring filter.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against country/region name, e.g. "brazil".

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-unesco-uis forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the unesco-uis pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
